newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exports $974 mln in September's 2nd week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exports $974 mln in September's 2nd week.

text.p: Brazil exported $974 million in goods in the second week of September, with the daily average reaching $194.9 million, a spokeswoman for the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
She said the results for the second week brought September exports to date to $1.915 billion, with a daily average of $191.5 million.
Augst saw a trade deficit of $291 million, with total exports of $4.381 billion averaging $199.1 million a day.
